title: AgriFuseNet: background-free multi-organ feature fusion for sugarcane variety identification

creators.name: Hussain, Tassadaq
creators.affiliation: Centre for AI and Big Data and Department of Electrical Engineering, Namal University, Mianwali, Pakistan

creators.name: Younis, Kamran
creators.affiliation: Centre for AI and Big Data, Namal University, Mianwali, Pakistan

description:
Source code of AgriFuseNet, a background-free multi-organ system for image-based sugarcane variety identification, and of the leakage- and session-aware evaluation used in the accompanying article.

The code isolates the leaf blade, leaf top, bud and stalk cross-section with text-prompted Segment Anything 3, describes the leaf blade with a channel-wise attention fusion of masked-blade, vein-resolving tile and botanical descriptors, and combines any subset of organs with a permutation-invariant organ-set network trained with organ dropout. It also implements the data curation, leakage groups, capture periods, grouped and session-level cross-validation, background-swap and cross-board diagnostics, and the inference benchmarks. All results are regenerated from the public Sugarcane-PK v1.0 dataset (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18619387); no images are included.
